cause: The user does not exist or the bot cannot see them.
fix: Check the id. The person may have deleted their account.

cause: The person's privacy settings refuse this DM.
fix: Do not retry. Reach them in a server channel.

cause: The server paused DMs between its members.
fix: Do not retry. A moderator lifts the pause.

cause: The person blocked the bot.
An official Zrzur account cannot be replied to, reacted to, pinned or reported.
The channel is gone or the bot cannot see it.
fix: Check the id and that the bot has View Channel.

cause: The message is gone, or it is not in this channel.
A file id in the body does not exist or was already used.
fix: Upload the file again. Each upload can be used once.

cause: The message cannot be deleted, for example one this interaction did not create.
fix: Delete only what your bot wrote, or get Manage Messages.

cause: A bot can only edit its own messages.
The channel takes no calls.
The message has more files than `max`.
fix: Send the files in several messages.

cause: The message has more embeds than `max`.
The message replies to more messages than `max`.
The server reached its channel limit, `max`.
The channel reached its limit of webhooks.
fix: Delete a webhook in this channel.

cause: The server reached its limit of webhooks.
fix: Delete a webhook in this server.

cause: A webhook sent too much. The body has `retry_after` in milliseconds.
fix: Wait that long, then send again.

cause: A webhook posted to a forum without a thread.
The server switched threads off. What exists stays readable.
fix: Do not retry. Only the server can switch them back on.

cause: The server switched forums off. What exists stays readable.
fix: Do not retry. Only the server can switch them back on.

cause: Plugins are switched off on this server. No plugin route answers while they are off.
fix: Do not retry. Plugins come back only when the server turns them on.

cause: The message has no content, embeds, attachments or components.
The message is over a size limit.
fix: Shorten the text or the embeds.

cause: The message is already pinned.
The message is not pinned.
The channel has slowmode and the bot wrote too soon. The body has `retry_after`.
fix: Wait, or give the bot Bypass Slowmode. This is a refusal, not a rate limit.

cause: The server does not exist or the bot is not in it.
fix: Check the id. Forget a server when you get `ServerDelete`.

cause: The role does not exist in this server.
This user is banned from the server.
fix: A moderator removes the ban first.

cause: The bot is already in this server.
The target of the timeout is the bot itself.
The server reached its emoji limit, `max`.
The server reached its role limit, `max`.
The application does not exist.
fix: Check the id: an application id is the bot's user id.

cause: Someone used a bot that is not in this server.
fix: Install the bot in the server.

cause: The bot was suspended or switched off, so it receives nothing.
Your HTTP interaction address failed its test. `reason` says why.
The command id is unknown, or it was deleted.
A command with this name and type already exists in this scope.
fix: Use `PUT` to replace the list, or edit the command.

cause: The limit of `max` commands of this type in one scope is reached.
The interaction id or token is wrong.
fix: Use the values from `InteractionCreate` as they are.

cause: The 3 seconds to acknowledge, or the 15 minutes of the token, are over.
fix: Acknowledge sooner. Use `DeferredMessage` for slow work.

cause: This interaction already has its first answer.
fix: Use a follow-up, or edit the original.

cause: The limit of `max` follow-ups for one interaction is reached.
fix: Edit a message, or send a normal message.

cause: This route is for people. Bots are refused.
fix: Do it another way. The reference marks what bots can use.

cause: Only the owner can install a private bot.
fix: Sign in as the owner, or make the bot public.

cause: The bot lacks the permission named in `permission`.
fix: Give the bot that permission, or tell the person.

cause: The person the bot acts for lacks the permission in `permission`.
The route or connection needs the intent named in `intent`.
fix: Switch it on in the Developer Portal and ask for it when you connect.

cause: The masquerade name copies another member.
An unverified bot stops at 100 servers.
The server's verification level refuses this member for now. `requirement` says why.
fix: Wait, or ask the server's moderators.

cause: The server's AutoMod rule `rule` refused the message.
fix: Change the text. Do not retry the same text.

cause: The member has not accepted the server's rules.
fix: Tell them to accept the rules.

cause: The server paused invites.
fix: Do not retry. A moderator lifts the pause.

cause: The target ranks at or above the bot, or the role is above the bot's top role.
The bot's rank is too low for this change.
The bot tried to give a permission it does not have itself.
fix: Give the bot that permission first.

cause: Only the owner can do this.
The target ranks too high for this.
Something failed on the server.
fix: Wait and retry with a growing delay. Report it if it stays.

cause: The request is not valid in this state, for example a `Modal` as the answer to a form.
fix: Check the rules of this route.

cause: The token, password or ticket is wrong.
A field combination is not allowed here.
The token is missing or wrong, or the bot was suspended.
fix: Stop and check the token. Retrying does not help.

cause: The route needs a token and got none.
The same `nonce` was used for a different request.
fix: Use a new value for each new message.

cause: The route or the object does not exist.
fix: Check the path and the ids.

cause: The request changes nothing.
The body breaks a limit or a rule. `error` says which in one line, and `fields` lists each field with its rule.
fix: Fix the body. Do not retry the same request.

cause: Voice is not available on this server.
The channel is not a voice channel.
The bot is already in this voice channel.
The member is not in a voice channel.
The voice node does not exist.
This server has the feature named in `feature` switched off.
fix: Do not retry. Self-hosted servers switch it on in their configuration.

cause: A header is too large, for example the audit log reason.
The link or media proxy could not fetch the address.
fix: Check that the address is public.

cause: The uploaded file is empty.
The file is over the limit of its tag, `max`.
This tag takes images only.
The image could not be read.
The link has no preview data.
A required header is missing.
The action could not finish.
The stored data does not match. `with` names it.
A database call failed on the server.
fix: Wait and retry with a growing delay.

cause: The old voice service is unavailable.
The server could not render a template.
An unlabelled server error.
fix: Retry later. Report it if it stays.

cause: The server wants a person to contact support. `msg` says why.
fix: Show the message to the owner.

cause: A flag has a value the server does not know.
The server's soundboard is full.
fix: Remove a sound first. `max` is the limit.

cause: This library sound is on the server's soundboard already.
The sound library is not ready yet.
The stage has as many speakers as it may have.
fix: Move a speaker back to the audience first. `max` is the limit.

cause: The poll is over: no more votes, and it cannot be ended again.
The account already has a username.
The account has not declared its age.
fix: People only: finish it in the app.

cause: The username is taken.
The username has characters that are not allowed.
The name tag changed too recently.
The users are friends already.
A friend request is pending.
The user is blocked.
This needs a friendship.
The person refuses group invites.
Too many friend requests are pending.
The group owner cannot remove themselves.
The group is full.
The user is already in the group.
The user is not in the group.
This account cannot create servers. Bots never can.
fix: Create the server as a person.

cause: The account reached its server limit.
The server cannot have a custom address.
The custom address is taken.
The custom address is reserved.
The custom address is paused.
The creator reached the limit of items.
This needs a Zrzur staff permission.
The platform word list stopped this text.
The gallery item changed meanwhile.
Too many reports in a short time.
The safety case changed meanwhile.
The limit of Wings is reached.
The account made 7 bots in the last 7 days.
fix: Wait until `resets_at`, then create the bot.

cause: All promotion slots are taken.
The server is not on Discover.
The account reached its limit of bots.
This route is for bots.
People cannot report themselves.
The captcha failed.
The sign-up shield refused the request.
The account's e-mail is not verified.
The e-mail could not be sent.
The link or code is wrong or has expired.
This server needs an invite to sign up.
The invite is wrong.
The password is on a list of leaked passwords.
The password is too short.
Too many failed sign-ins.
The authenticator is already on.
This check is not allowed here.
The account is too young for this.
The age cannot be changed.
The content is limited by age.
The server has as many scheduled events as it may have.
A message from a mature channel can only be forwarded into another mature channel.
